title: RHEL Server Patch with Pre and Post Verification
description: Patches a RHEL server by verifying pre-patch memory and disk space, updating all packages, rebooting, and verifying post-patch system health including memory, disk space, and service continuity.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: The hostname or IP address of the RHEL server to patch

parameters.name: min_free_memory_mb
parameters.description: Minimum free memory required before patching; recommended value is 2048 MB (2 GB)

parameters.name: min_free_disk_gb
parameters.description: Minimum free disk space required on each filesystem; recommended value is 5 GB

parameters.name: fs_exclude_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of mount points to exclude from disk space checks

parameters.name: fs_type_exclude_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of filesystem types to exclude from disk space checks

parameters.name: reboot_timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait for the server to come back up after reboot; recommended value is 120 seconds

parameters.name: package_name
parameters.description: Name of the package(s) to update; use * for all packages

playbook_output.description: Emits step statuses, post-patch memory status, post-patch mount point status, and service mismatch list.

fields.name: step_statuses
fields.description: Status of each step in the playbook (pass/fail)

fields.name: post_patch_memory_status
fields.description: Post-patch free memory status including whether it meets the minimum threshold

fields.name: post_patch_mount_status
fields.description: Post-patch mount point status including which filesystems have insufficient free space

fields.name: service_mismatch_list
fields.description: List of services that differ between pre-patch and post-patch states

steps.name: Gather pre-patch system facts
steps.function: Collect system facts including memory information from the target server before patching.

steps.name: Check pre-patch free memory
steps.function: Branch on whether the pre-patch free memory meets the minimum threshold.
steps.condition: Pre-patch free memory is below the minimum threshold.

steps.name: Gather pre-patch disk space information
steps.function: Collect disk space information for all filesystems not in the exclude list.

steps.name: Check pre-patch disk space
steps.function: Branch on whether any filesystem has insufficient free disk space before patching.
steps.condition: At least one filesystem has insufficient free disk space.

steps.name: Collect pre-patch running systemd services
steps.function: Collect the list of all active systemd services before patching.

steps.name: Update all packages
steps.function: Update all packages on the target server using the package manager.

steps.name: Reboot the server
steps.function: Reboot the target server to apply the updates.

steps.name: Wait for server to come back up
steps.function: Wait for the server to become reachable via SSH after reboot.

steps.name: Check if server came back up
steps.function: Branch on whether the server failed to come back up within the timeout period.
steps.condition: The server failed to come back up within the reboot timeout period.

steps.name: Gather post-patch system facts
steps.function: Collect system facts including memory information from the target server after patching.

steps.name: Check post-patch free memory
steps.function: Branch on whether the post-patch free memory meets the minimum threshold.
steps.condition: Post-patch free memory is below the minimum threshold.

steps.name: Gather post-patch disk space information
steps.function: Collect disk space information for all filesystems not in the exclude list after patching.

steps.name: Check post-patch disk space
steps.function: Branch on whether any filesystem has insufficient free disk space after patching.
steps.condition: At least one filesystem has insufficient free disk space.

steps.name: Collect post-patch running systemd services
steps.function: Collect the list of all active systemd services after patching.

steps.name: Compare pre and post-patch services
steps.function: Branch on whether the post-patch service list differs from the pre-patch service list.
steps.condition: The post-patch service list differs from the pre-patch service list.

steps.name: Build final report
steps.function: Compile all step statuses, post-patch memory status, post-patch mount point status, and service mismatch list into a final report.

computations._step_statuses: Build a summary of pass/fail status for each step in the playbook.
computations._post_patch_memory_status: Format the post-patch free memory value and whether it meets the minimum threshold.
computations._post_patch_mount_status: Format the post-patch mount point status including which filesystems have insufficient free space.
computations._service_mismatch_list: Compare pre-patch and post-patch service lists and list any services that differ.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the Required Output Format <result> block on success.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Collect system state and validate prerequisites before applying changes.

phases.name: Main action
phases.description: Apply the patch by updating all packages and rebooting the server.

phases.name: Post-checks
phases.description: Verify the system is healthy after the patch by checking memory, disk space, and services.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Build and emit the structured final report to the caller.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
